title: Montenegro Magic: A Yoga & Nature Retreat

teachers.name: Bonnie Erickson
bio: Born in England, raised in California, and seasoned with the grit of 20 years in New York City, Bonnie brings a lifetime of movement, mindfulness, and heart-centered teaching to the mat.

A lifelong dancer, her path has been anything but linear — from opening restaurants for Wolfgang Puck and editing for The New York Times to spending twelve years as Director of Educational Programming at Broadway Dance Center in NYC. Through it all, movement has remained a constant.

After nearly two decades as a devoted yoga student, Bonnie stepped into teaching and has since guided more than 2,500 classes. She is currently continuing her studies through Stanford’s YogaX program, with a focus on therapeutic yoga.

Known for her soothing voice, deep warmth, healing touch, and wonderfully silly spirit, Bonnie creates classes that are thoughtful and grounding without ever taking themselves too seriously. Expect to breathe deeply, move freely, laugh often, and leave feeling invigorated, integrated, inspired, and joyful.
Come breathe, move, laugh, and maybe even dance with the BEE.

intro: Escape to the stunning Bay of Kotor, Montenegro, for a transformative yoga and wellness retreat. Set in the idyllic village of Perast, this experience blends daily yoga practices with immersive adventures, creating the perfect balance of relaxation and exploration.
about_body: Montenegro is a tiny country nestled into the Balkans between Croatia and Albania. Its majestic landscapes lend to epic vistas, incredible hiking, serene water activities and offer the traveler a truly unique experience. From the moment you arrive into the Bay of Kotor you’ll be transported by a medieval village overlooking the most magical waters and mystical mountain range.

Our retreat to this magical little land highlights life on the water and all that entails. We will paddle to fantastical islands, spend a day boating around the nooks and crannies visiting caves, seaside dining spots, underwater wineries and enjoying the freshest seafood available. Our historical private villa overlooks the Bay and is nestled into the most charming village of Perast, a UNESCO heritage site. Explore the town of Kotor on our walking food tour, visit a working olive oil farm at the top of the ridge, climb 1,350 steps to the top of the city to admire the bird’s eye views.

Yoga and wellness will anchor each day. Practices will be guided by our incredible instructors, pamper yourself in the hot tub or sauna overlooking the Bay and opt for nature bathing as you hike to the top of Kotor on the most stunning hike in the area.
We are SO excited to share this incredible experience with you. Space is limited and this retreat will sell out quickly! Reserve your space below.

text: We’ll stay in a 16th century luxury villa, nestled in the charming UNESCO-protected village of Perast, in the heart of the Bay of Kotor. Surrounded by timeless stone architecture and breathtaking sea views, the villa offers complete privacy and the perfect setting to unwind.

Our 300 year old villa – painstakingly renovated to mirror the tradition and heritage of the area – provides unimpeded views across the glittering red rooftops of Perast and out on to the cool water of the bay. Each aspect has been meticulously integrated to ensure that it offers an unparalleled experience where guests are enveloped in opulence and comfort while feeling truly at home.

Our pool area, featuring an exquisite infinity pool, stands as the hallmark of our villa. With its breathtaking, uninterrupted views of the bay and neighboring islands, complemented by the serene presence of the monastery next door, it radiates an unparalleled energy that invites guests to immerse themselves in complete relaxation and tranquility, offering a sanctuary where the stresses of the world simply melt away.
Pamper yourself with the jacuzzi and sauna overlooking the bay in your free time.

travel_tips.heading: Getting to Perast
items: Perast is a picturesque village in the Bay of Kotor, easily accessible from several airports in the region. Here are your options:
Tivat Airport (TIV): The closest airport, just 20 minutes from Perast. From Tivat, you can take a taxi or pre-arranged transfer for a quick and scenic drive.

Podgorica Airport (TGD): Montenegro’s capital airport, about 1.5 hours from Perast. Taxis or private transfers are available, or you can rent a car to enjoy the drive through Montenegro’s beautiful landscapes.

Dubrovnik Airport (DBV) in Croatia: Approximately 1.5–2 hours away. Crossing the border into Montenegro is straightforward but can take extra time during peak travel seasons. Arrange a transfer or rent a car for this option.

travel_tips.heading: Currency in Montenegro
items: The currency used in Montenegro is the Euro (EUR). Credit cards are widely accepted in most places, but it’s a good idea to carry some cash for small shops, cafes, or transportation in smaller towns like Perast.

travel_tips.heading: What to Bring for a Retreat in May
items: May in Montenegro offers pleasant spring weather with mild temperatures. Here’s what to pack:
Comfortable clothing for yoga and wellness sessions (breathable and stretchable fabrics).
Layers: A light jacket, sweater, or scarf for cooler mornings and evenings.
Casual attire for exploring Perast and nearby attractions.
Hiking shoes or sturdy sneakers for trails and viewpoints.
Swimwear for kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, or boat trips.
Sun protection: Sunscreen, sunglasses, and a wide-brimmed hat.
A reusable water bottle to stay hydrated.
Daypack or backpack for excursions and hikes.
Travel adapters (if needed) for European-style outlets (Type C or F).

travel_tips.heading: Pro Tip
items: If flying into Dubrovnik or Podgorica, check visa requirements for crossing borders. It’s always a good idea to pre-arrange transfers for seamless travel to Perast, especially if you’re arriving late or with heavy luggage. If you would like help with airport transfers please let us know and we will try to pair travelers arriving at similar times together.

faqs.question: Do you accept bitcoin?
answer: In addition to credit card payments we also accept wire transfers, Zelle and Bitcoin. Please inquire for more details.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
answer: All payments are 100% non refundable and non-transferable. We recommend that you buy trip cancellation insurance immediately upon making your initial deposit to cover any travel hiccups or complications that may arise between now and the time of your retreat. No exceptions are possible so please cover your trip by connecting with an insurance company that offers the right policy for you.

faqs.question: What happens if my travel plans change?
answer: There are no refunds as per our cancellation policies. We highly recommend that all of our guests secure a quality travel insurance that will cover them for any event which may cause a change of travel plans, including personal health issues or personal situations in general which may affect travel plans.

faqs.question: Are flight delays or cancellations covered?
answer: Not by us: transportation delays, cancellations or changes due to strikes, labor disputes, or lockouts from airlines, boats, ferries or any type of transportation are among the events we recommend covering with travel insurance.

faqs.question: Where can I find the full terms & conditions?
answer: The full terms and conditions are published at https://yogaadventuresworldwide.com/termsandconditions/ . By submitting payments toward your retreat you accept them.
